body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Sony Korea presented its 120Hz full HD LCD TV ‘Bravia W series’ during KES 2007, which targets premium TV market in Korea. Featuring luxurious aluminum and black frames, the W series is expected to be released in October for U.S and Europe market, and on November 2 for Korea market. Suggested price is around 500,000(KRW) cheaper than Bravia X series.
